Case: the spec home is unreachable and nothing was classified
Asserts: A1
Home: unreachable
Records: 0
Expect: clean
Findings: 0
Why: R19 obeyed. The spec named by this tree's own config is not there, and no
  classification was recorded against a remembered copy - the lifecycle
  stopped. This tree and 02-classified-anyway are identical but for the one
  record, which is the two-tree experiment that showed check-spec-home.sh
  cannot tell R19 obeyed from R19 violated. A check that only ever proves it
  can say no is half a check, so this case is the honest inverse.
